name: arrow-in-ground-pickup
comment: WP-2.4. Two stone layers (y = 59, 60). EntityArrow(World) (id 0) at (0.5, 64, 0.5) with motion (0.3, -0.6, 0.1): the first onUpdate derives its rotation from the motion (EntityArrow.java:88-92); rayTraceBlocks_do_do hits the platform top, the arrow backs off 0.05 along its motion, sticks (inGround, arrowShake 7, inTile/inData) and counts ticksInGround. The arrow sticks in block (1, 60, 0). A player (id 1) stands at (-4.5, 61, 0.5), is moved onto the arrow at t = 20 (set_pos with posY = 61 + yOffset 1.62F, feet on the platform) and back at t = 25: EntityPlayer.onLivingUpdate calls the arrow's onCollideWithPlayer, which does nothing because a spawned arrow does not belong to a player (doesArrowBelongToPlayer false, EntityArrow.java:259), so the WP-2.5 inventory pickup is never reached. At t = 30 the block it is stuck in, (1, 60, 0), is removed: the arrow's motion is scaled by three rand floats (EntityArrow.java:117-122), it flies again and sticks in the layer below. rng_state every tick, entity_state of the arrow every tick.
